title: Smashed cucumber and roast chicken salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Whole chicken, new potatoes, cucumber, yoghurt, vinegar, honey and herbs are all plain home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including the whole chicken and watercress, is an everyday Tesco purchase at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a sieve, a pan for bashing and a platter, and every technique suits a beginner.

works.reason: A 1.5kg chicken roasted for 1 hour 20 minutes with potatoes in its fat, plus 750g potatoes, two cucumbers and watercress, makes a sound, well-dressed salad for four.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes covers halving potatoes, smashing cucumber, chopping herbs and pulling the chicken, and 95 minutes of cook time fits the 80-minute roast plus resting.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Two smashed cucumbers form the main salad in a light May dinner, so the cucumber is central rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: Steps such as 'bash into chunks with a pan' read like plain, friendly British kitchen instructions.

hearty_healthy.reason: Roast chicken, potatoes, cucumber, watercress and yoghurt make a balanced, filling family dinner.
